evidence.r1: Only the Reduce-transparency toggle, the Playing Next queue panel, Save Queue button and the transport/volume bar are glass; the left track-list column is an opaque content panel, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r2: The queue panel, Save Queue button and transport bar occupy separate non-overlapping regions of the artwork, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r3: Five floating glass elements (toggle, queue, save, transport, volume), each load-bearing, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r4: All floating elements show the same frosted regular-glass look over the ice artwork in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear-variant glass is used; the Add-to-playlist popover (shot-menu-light) matches the same frosted treatment.
evidence.r6: No floating control carries a saturated tint distinct from neutral white/dark glass in either scheme; Save Queue and the transport bar are both neutral.
evidence.r7: The queue panel and transport bar show blur and the ice texture through them rather than a flat fill, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r8: The transport play/prev/next buttons are capsules (circles); the queue panel and playlist popover are fixed-radius rounded rectangles, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r9: The 'Late Desk' row highlighted in the playlist popover sits inset from the popover's own corner radius without pinching, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r10: The transport buttons are capsules; the Save Queue button is a capsule pairing text with its own chevron rather than a dense rectangle, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r11: The queue panel, Save Queue button, and the transport+volume bar form three separate glass groups, within the group limit, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r12: Save Queue pairs one text label with its own chevron as a single control; the transport bar holds icon buttons only, so no pill mixes a separate text button with a separate icon button, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r13: Glass is applied to each panel's outer shape; track rows and icons sit on one shared surface rather than being individually glassed, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r14: The queue panel and Save Queue button keep a visible gap from each other and from the transport bar, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r15: shot-full-light/dark are pixel-identical to shot-fv-light/dark; the track list and artwork never show content scrolling beneath a floating bar in these captures.
evidence.r16: The queue panel and transport bar sit over the textured ice artwork, never a flat field, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r17: Only the artwork, not the track list, sits beneath the floating queue panel and transport bar at rest, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r18: Black queue/transport text in light mode and white text in dark mode both read clearly against the frosted fill over the pale ice image.
evidence.r19: shot-reduced only shows the transparency switch turning panels solid; no increased-contrast or reduced-motion state is captured.
evidence.r20: The left track-list column occupies a fixed roughly 470px-wide strip of the window in shot-fv-light/dark, so the artwork never fills the whole window as the brief intends; the column sits beside the artwork rather than the artwork reaching that edge.
evidence.r21: The artwork meets the track-list column at a sharp vertical seam with no gradient or background extension in shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r22: The Add-to-playlist popover (shot-menu-light/dark) adds no dark scrim behind it beyond its own glass edge.
evidence.r23: Only the playlist popover's position directly below Save Queue (shot-menu-light) can be checked from stills, not morph or press feedback.
evidence.r24: Queue and transport text/icons are monochrome black/white in both schemes; the orange now-playing indicator sits in the track-list content column, not a glass control.
evidence.r25: Black queue text in light mode and white text in dark mode both stay distinct from the pale ice artwork behind them.
